column1: # evidence/perf-baseline.tsv — the W55 perf floor (ROADMAP-V2 W55)
# jvm rows: kind=key value=measured@pin budget=enforced line (the gate re-measures and enforces measured<=budget)
# device rows: value=Perf.LIMITS good budget=LIMITS ok — the anti-rewrite guard compares src/Perf.java vs this file
# the record is SELF-CONSISTENT: every jvm budget == derive(value) at %.3f (p50 v*1.5+1 / p95 v*1.5+2 / load v*2+500 / heap v*2+10)
# changing any line = a documented owner decision in NOTES.md (the W54 ceiling pattern) — never a quiet edit
